headline: Nvidia Jumps On AI Bid, Software Stocks Dip: Stock Market Today
summary: Nvidia surges 4.7%, while Credo, MongoDB and Palo Alto all cratered Wednesday despite quarterly beats, as costs surged.

headline: Worst US-Iran Escalation Since July Puts Oil, Defense ETFs in Focus as Hormuz Risk Sends Crude Higher
summary: The worst U.S.-Iran escalation since July is pushing oil higher and putting energy and defense ETFs in focus as Strait of Hormuz disruption risks mount.
